Class SshClientTheme.PlateTabUi

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.plaf.ComponentUI
javax.swing.plaf.TabbedPaneUI
javax.swing.plaf.basic.BasicTabbedPaneUI
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshClientTheme.PlateTabUi
All Implemented Interfaces:
SwingConstants
Enclosing class:
SshClientTheme
private static final class SshClientTheme.PlateTabUi extends BasicTabbedPaneUI
The PlateTabUi paints the product tabs. A selected tab uses the sapphire fill. An idle tab uses the grey fill. A hover on an unselected tab lightens that face and draws an edge. A disabled tab is drawn at half opacity. The content border is not painted.

    • installDefaults

      protected void installDefaults()
      The installDefaults method keeps the stock tab defaults and then sets the insets. The content border inset is zero on every side. The tab inset is two, eight, two, and eight. The selected-tab pad is zero on every side. The tab-area inset is two, two, zero, and two.
      Overrides:
      installDefaults in class BasicTabbedPaneUI

    • paintTabArea

      protected void paintTabArea(Graphics g, int tabPlacement, int selectedIndex)
      The paintTabArea method fills the strip and then paints the tabs. A null tab pane skips the fill. The fill is red 13, green 13, blue 13. The rectangle starts inside the pane insets. The height is the tab-area height. A bottom placement moves the rectangle up from the bottom inset. A negative width or height is painted as zero. The stock tab paint runs after the fill.
      Overrides:
      paintTabArea in class BasicTabbedPaneUI
      Parameters:
      g - The graphics context.
      tabPlacement - The tab edge.
      selectedIndex - The selected tab.

    • paintTabBackground

      protected void paintTabBackground(Graphics g, int tabPlacement, int tabIndex, int x, int y, int w, int h, boolean isSelected)
      The paintTabBackground method paints one rounded tab. Antialiasing is turned on. plateAlpha(Graphics2D, int) halves a disabled tab. A selected tab uses the sapphire fill. An unselected hover uses the hover fill. Any other tab uses the idle fill. The corner arc is twelve pixels. An unselected hover also strokes the hover edge with a one-pixel stroke. The graphics copy is disposed.
      Overrides:
      paintTabBackground in class BasicTabbedPaneUI
      Parameters:
      g - The graphics context.
      tabPlacement - The tab edge. This method does not read it.
      tabIndex - The tab being painted.
      x - The left edge.
      y - The top edge.
      w - The width.
      h - The height.
      isSelected - True when this tab is selected.

    • paintText

      protected void paintText(Graphics g, int tabPlacement, Font font, FontMetrics metrics, int tabIndex, String title, Rectangle textRect, boolean isSelected)
      The paintText method paints one tab title. A null title returns immediately. A null text rectangle returns immediately. A null metrics object returns immediately. plateAlpha(Graphics2D, int) halves a disabled tab. The font is the supplied font. A selected tab uses the sapphire word color. An unselected hover uses the hover word color. Any other tab uses the idle word color. The baseline is the text rectangle's top plus the font ascent. The text starts at the text rectangle's left. The graphics copy is disposed.
      Overrides:

      tabIndex - The tab being painted.
      title - The tab title.
      textRect - The text rectangle.
      isSelected - True when this tab is selected.

    • plateAlpha

      private void plateAlpha(Graphics2D g2, int tabIndex)
      The plateAlpha method halves a disabled tab. A null tab pane does nothing. An enabled tab does nothing. A disabled tab uses source-over compositing at one half.
      Parameters:
      g2 - The graphics copy.
      tabIndex - The tab to test.
